rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Cal, Eli, Fay, Ben, Dev, Ada. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 2 and 6 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Cal.say: Cal here. The storehouse can't keep all six of us alive: we need 30 rations in total and have 6 plus about 4 a day. Proposal: we concentrate rations on as many people as possible, 5 each, and everyone else accepts that they may not make it. I'm claiming 6 today so I can hold a full supply, and I'll share any spare with whoever is closest to starving. Let's agree on who gets claims each day so we don't split the storehouse and lose everyone.

Eli.say: Eli here. The storehouse can't feed all six of us for five nights (about 30 rations needed, and we'll get at most 6 plus roughly 2-6 a day). I propose we concentrate supplies so as many people as possible survive: whoever claims now holds the rations, and anything beyond what they need can be passed to others. I'm claiming the full 6 today and will share my surplus once the delivery is in. Please say what you're claiming so we can plan who gets what.

Fay.say: Fay here. Storehouse is only 6 plus 2-6 per day, and we need 5 each, so we can't all survive. Concentrating rations saves more people than splitting them. I'm claiming all 6 today so I can last all 5 nights, and I'll pass any surplus to whoever is closest to starving. Suggest everyone else claim 0 today so the stock isn't split and wasted.

Ben.say: Ben here. The storehouse has only 6 plus a delivery of 2 to 6 per day, and six of us need 5 rations each to last. We can't all survive, so let's agree to concentrate food in a few people rather than split it into scraps that let everyone starve. I'm claiming 6 today so I can hold rations and pass them out where they keep someone alive. Please tell everyone what you're claiming and holding so we can decide who gets the stock.

Dev.say: Dev here. Storehouse holds 6 now, plus 2-6 delivered today. Total supply over the 5 days is only about 26 rations, and the six of us need 30 to last. Not everyone can survive, so if we all claim at once we'll split too thin and lose more people. I'm claiming 6 today, which should come through in full. Suggestion: claims go to whoever can actually make it to day 5, and everyone who holds spare rations shares them with those closest to starving. Tell me your holdings and I'll help work out the split.

Ada.say: Ada here. Storehouse math: six villagers need 30 rations to last 5 nights, but we have 6 plus about 4 per day, so roughly 26 total. Not everyone can survive unless we concentrate rations. Proposal: we don't all claim at once, since over-claiming gets split proportionally and wastes rations. I'm claiming 5 today to start building a full ration for one person.
